title: GPT-5 Mini gets room for longer responses
summary:
Longer GPT-5 Mini responses, more reliable daily Pollen refills, and better previews for community apps.

GPT-5 Mini’s maximum completion tokens increased from 1,024 to 16,384. A follow-up corrected its provider routing.

The bulk refill now tracks whether the job has run separately from individual login refills, so one person’s login no longer causes the job to skip everyone else. The microbe tier was added to the daily refill.

Eleven app pages received updated titles, descriptions, sharing metadata or install assets. The app tooling now generates dedicated link previews and uses the app registry to decide what to build.

highlights.title: Longer GPT-5 Mini responses
highlights.text: `gpt-5-mini` now allows up to 16,384 completion tokens, up from 1,024. [Browse the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=gpt-5-mini).
